scope: Read-only Marketplace initial-navigation diagnostics before further model-led learning. Each browser used its own existing or freshly allocated profile; no authentication data was copied or deleted.
interpretation: The old/fresh/old contrast suggests a profile-dependent failure. macOS-offloaded entries may be relevant, but no causal link, profile corruption, logout or site denial has been established.
measurementLimits: Not a randomized control or a learning/replay benchmark; website state can change between sequential observations.
Fresh-profile negative authentication checks are not proof of signed-in state.
All browser-only diagnostics deliberately invoke zero model operations; that does not establish model usage for the earlier failed learning trial.
The pre-fix browser wrapper suppressed close failures. Its cleanup passed flag proves only that the wrapper resolved, not that Chrome shutdown was independently verified.
The recorded navigation abort has no event timing and may have resulted from timeout cleanup.
Filesystem metadata inspection did not read cookie, local-storage, service-worker or preference contents. Dataless entry counts are not a corruption diagnosis.
nextBoundary: Resolve initial navigation using an intact authorized local profile before attempting fresh schema-first learning again. Preserve the saved profile and original investigation cutoff.
